usage: tunnel mode [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--session NAME]
                   [{passthrough,replay}]

positional arguments:
  {passthrough,replay}  leave it out to print the mode as it stands

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           where the admin API answers (default
                        http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json                print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --session NAME        switch the current session in the same call, so that
                        `mode replay --session acct_a` is one command
